limitations: Released labels and previously inspected cases are not a fresh blind test.
GT IDs are connected annotated bands, not verified global physical sheet identities.
The inherited algorithm keeps the largest component of each decode, drops final instances <500 voxels, and deduplicates geometric twins; topology of these outputs does not isolate the AE effect.
Fixed absolute latent thresholds are transferred without calibration; checkpoint effects include possible latent-scale drift.
